summary: Obvious optimizations don't works in "inline if"
labels: ['Type-Defect', 'Priority-Medium']
stars: 1
commentCount: 2
Comment 0 (2011-04-08): Try it (advanced mode): alert(true == null ? a() : b()); EVER true != null, in this case, EVER will trigger b(), but we get: alert(!0 == null ? a() : b()); Same for: alert(true == false ? a() : b()); Real life use: function sum(a, b){ return (a == true ? 2 : a) + b; } alert(sum(true, 1)); Results in: alert((!0 == !0 ? 2 : 1) + 1); But correct is: alert(3);
Comment 1 (2011-04-11): This issue was closed by revision r982.
